label: Catalogue order without a quantity up to
description: In the chat: a request that names a catalogue item but no quantity is offered from the catalogue only up to this value; above it, it becomes new demand.

label: Sourcing request form from
description: In the chat: under it the route card says business-led demand (three quotes, no sourcing request form) and the chat asks the shorter business-led questions. From it the Category Manager decides or procurement leads, the chat asks the procurement-led questions and the route card adds the sourcing request form.

label: Procurement leads from
description: In the chat: from it (a year) the route card says procurement-led demand with an RFP, and the chat asks the full procurement-led questions.

label: Material spend review from
description: In the chat: a total from this value adds the material spend review to the route card and the record.

label: Quality needed before submitting
description: In the chat: below this score the chat offers to go through the points that would lift it before submitting.

label: Tips for thin answers
description: In the chat: a new-demand answer rated this or lower gets one tip on making it usable for sourcing (0 turns the tips off).

label: Level 4 candidates shown from
description: In the chat: after the first message every Level 4 at this match or more is offered on the category card; weaker ones are added only to reach the fewest shown, and are marked "weaker match".

label: Level 4 candidates shown: at most
description: In the chat: the most categories the category card offers after the first message (the suggested one included).

label: Level 4 candidates shown: at least
description: In the chat: the fewest categories offered; when fewer reach the match above, the next best are added as "weaker match".

label: Low-confidence match below
description: In the chat: a match below this is marked low confidence, and the request's words alone never pick or change a category without the requester choosing it.

label: Additional categories a request may have
description: In the chat: after choosing the main category the requester can add up to this many more ("Also includes"). Their category rules and review flags apply too, a contract must cover all of them, and they are listed in the record. 0 turns this off.

label: Headline, procurement-led: at most
description: In the chat: the longest headline the service description may have for procurement-led demand.

label: Headline, procurement-led: at least
description: In the chat: a shorter headline for procurement-led demand is flagged as too thin in the quality check.

label: Executive description, procurement-led: at most
description: In the chat: the longest executive description for procurement-led demand.

label: Executive description, procurement-led: at least
description: In the chat: a shorter executive description for procurement-led demand is flagged as too thin.

label: Headline, other routes: at most
description: In the chat: the longest headline for business-led demand and existing contracts.

label: Headline, other routes: at least
description: In the chat: a shorter headline for business-led demand and existing contracts is flagged as too thin.

label: Executive description, other routes: at most
description: In the chat: the longest executive description for business-led demand and existing contracts.

label: Executive description, other routes: at least
description: In the chat: a shorter executive description for business-led demand and existing contracts is flagged as too thin.

label: Budget for consulting, IT, legal or cloud work queried below
description: In the chat: a budget under this for consulting, IT, legal or cloud work gets the follow-up "Is that the total budget, or should it be higher?"

label: Advisory work: a day per person queried below
description: In the chat: advisory work whose budget works out under this per person and day (budget ÷ people × months × 20) is queried.

label: Typical day rate quoted: from
description: In the chat: named in that follow-up as the usual lower day rate per person.

label: Typical day rate quoted: to
description: In the chat: named in that follow-up as the usual upper day rate per person.

label: Three months or more of work queried below
description: In the chat: three months or more of services for less than this gets the follow-up "Is that the total budget?"

label: A total is confirmed above
description: In the chat: a total above this is confirmed with the requester before the chat goes on.

label: External workers: total may differ from day rate × days by
description: In the chat: for external workers, a total further than this from day rate × days is queried.

label: Points off per warning
description: In the chat: points the quality score loses for each warning (a confirmed issue, an unanswered question, a missing data location).

label: Points off per note
description: In the chat: points the quality score loses for each note (an estimate, an open budget approval, a tight timeline).

label: Points off per missing percent of details
description: In the chat: points lost for each percent of the needed details still open.

label: Points off per thin section
description: In the chat: points lost for each section of the service description that is partial or to be determined.

label: Points off per risky section
description: In the chat: points lost for each section rated as a risk.

label: Section points off at most
description: In the chat: the most the section penalties can take off together.

label: Lowest score
description: In the chat: the score shown never goes below this.

label: Rated Strong from
description: In the chat: the rating shown next to the score is Strong from here.

label: Rated Good from
description: In the chat: Good from here.

label: Rated Fair from
description: In the chat: Fair from here; below it, Needs work.
